title: "DeepCC CRC Scenario 1: CMS4 vs Others, TCGA to GSE13294, Strict SSV ml_sum Workflow"

# 0) Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(hgu133plus2.db)
  library(ggplot2)
})

set.seed(20260421)

# Do not modify this file. It contains ml_sum(), result_plot(), and result_plot2().
source("SSV summary.R")

result_dir <- "results_deepcc_gse13294_strict"
dir.create(result_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

cat("Setup done.\n")
cat("Working directory:", getwd(), "\n")
cat("Result directory:", result_dir, "\n")
```

# 1) Design

This file uses DeepCC CRC scenario 1 as a binary SSV adaptation:

-   `class_id = 1`: CMS4
-   `class_id = 0`: Others = CMS1 + CMS2 + CMS3
-   `batch_id = 1`: TCGA CRC RNA-seq
-   `batch_id = 2`: GSE13294 microarray
-   `split = 100`: strict cross-platform / cross-dataset validation, TCGA as train-like batch and GSE13294 as external batch.

Two leakage-control choices are used:

1.  Feature selection is based on the training platform only, TCGA, not on TCGA + GSE13294 combined.
2.  Cross-platform alignment is sample-wise, not train-test-combined. Each sample is transformed independently, so the test-set distribution is not used to normalize the training set.

`ml_sum()` is then called from `SSV summary.R`. Its non-RNA-seq `qn`, `mn`, and `vsn` branches are train/test separated internally, so they do not use the test matrix to fit the training transformation.

# 2) Parameters

```{r parameters}
train_expr_path <- "train_s1/TCGACRC.txt"
val_expr_path   <- "validation_s1/gse13294_rma_expression.tsv"
label_path      <- "label/cms_labels_public_all.txt"

train_dataset_name <- "tcga"
val_dataset_name   <- "gse13294"

valid_cms <- c("CMS1", "CMS2", "CMS3", "CMS4")
binary_positive_class <- "CMS4"
binary_negative_class <- "Others"

# ml_sum settings
split_combination <- c(50,70, 80, 90,100)
times <- 10
ml_methods <- c("knn", "lasso", "svm", "pam", "rf", "xgb")
batch_balance <- FALSE

# Feature selection is based on TCGA only to avoid external-cohort leakage.
feature_selection_method <- "top_train_mean"
top_n_features <- 1500

# Cross-platform alignment. Recommended: "sample_rank_normal".
# This transforms each sample independently and avoids train-test-combined normalization.
cross_platform_alignment <- "sample_rank_normal"

file_prefix <- file.path(result_dir, "deepcc_gse13294_CMS4_vs_Others_strict")

cat("Train expression path:", train_expr_path, "\n")
cat("Validation expression path:", val_expr_path, "\n")
cat("Label path:", label_path, "\n")
cat("Binary class:", binary_positive_class, "vs", binary_negative_class, "\n")
cat("Feature selection:", feature_selection_method, "top_n =", top_n_features, "\n")
cat("Cross-platform alignment:", cross_platform_alignment, "\n")
cat("File prefix:", file_prefix, "\n")
```

# 3) Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
to_numeric_matrix <- function(df_like) {
  mat <- as.matrix(df_like)
  mode(mat) <- "numeric"
  mat
}

is_probably_logscale <- function(mat) {
  q99 <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(mat, probs = 0.99, na.rm = TRUE))
  q99 < 50
}

clean_tcga_sample_id <- function(x) {
  substr(x, 1, 12)
}

clean_geo_sample_id <- function(x) {
  x |>
    gsub("\\.CEL$", "", x = _, ignore.case = TRUE) |>
    trimws()
}

read_tcga_expr <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Cannot find TCGA expression file: ", path)
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  if (length(lines) < 3) stop("TCGA file format unexpected: less than 3 lines.")

  header_tokens <- strsplit(lines[1], "\t", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  sample_ids <- header_tokens[-1]

  body <- read.delim(
    text = paste(lines[-c(1, 2)], collapse = "\n"),
    header = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  if (ncol(body) != length(sample_ids) + 1) {
    stop("TCGA parse mismatch: body columns do not match sample header columns.")
  }

  colnames(body) <- c("gene_id", sample_ids)
  body$gene_id <- as.character(body$gene_id)
  body <- body[!duplicated(body$gene_id), , drop = FALSE]
  body
}

read_geo_expr <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Cannot find GEO expression file: ", path)
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  if (length(lines) < 2) stop("Validation file format unexpected: less than 2 lines.")

  sample_ids <- strsplit(lines[1], "\t", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]

  body <- read.delim(
    text = paste(lines[-1], collapse = "\n"),
    header = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  if (ncol(body) != length(sample_ids) + 1) {
    stop("Validation parse mismatch: body columns do not match sample header columns.")
  }

  colnames(body) <- c("gene_id", sample_ids)
  body$gene_id <- as.character(body$gene_id)
  body <- body[!duplicated(body$gene_id), , drop = FALSE]
  body
}

clean_tcga_symbol_matrix <- function(mat) {
  keys <- rownames(mat)
  gene_symbol <- sub("\\|.*$", "", keys)
  gene_symbol <- trimws(gene_symbol)

  keep <- !is.na(gene_symbol) & gene_symbol != "" & gene_symbol != "?"
  mat2 <- mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  gene_symbol <- gene_symbol[keep]

  df <- as.data.frame(mat2, check.names = FALSE)
  df$gene_symbol <- gene_symbol

  df <- df |>
    dplyr::group_by(gene_symbol) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  out <- as.data.frame(df, check.names = FALSE)
  rownames(out) <- out$gene_symbol
  out$gene_symbol <- NULL
  as.matrix(out)
}

collapse_gse_probe_to_symbol <- function(mat) {
  probe_ids <- rownames(mat)

  symbol_map <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
    hgu133plus2.db,
    keys = probe_ids,
    column = "SYMBOL",
    keytype = "PROBEID",
    multiVals = "first"
  )

  keep <- !is.na(symbol_map) & symbol_map != ""
  mat2 <- mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  gene_symbol <- unname(symbol_map[keep])

  df <- as.data.frame(mat2, check.names = FALSE)
  df$gene_symbol <- gene_symbol

  df <- df |>
    dplyr::group_by(gene_symbol) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  out <- as.data.frame(df, check.names = FALSE)
  rownames(out) <- out$gene_symbol
  out$gene_symbol <- NULL
  as.matrix(out)
}

matrix_to_sample_df <- function(expr_gene_sample, sample_meta) {
  common_samples <- intersect(colnames(expr_gene_sample), sample_meta$sample_original)
  if (length(common_samples) == 0) {
    stop("No overlapping samples between expression matrix and metadata.")
  }

  expr_sub <- expr_gene_sample[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
  meta_sub <- sample_meta |>
    dplyr::filter(sample_original %in% common_samples) |>
    dplyr::arrange(match(sample_original, common_samples))

  x <- t(expr_sub)
  x <- as.data.frame(x, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  out <- dplyr::bind_cols(
    meta_sub |>
      dplyr::select(sample_original, sample_lookup, dataset, CMS, CMS_binary),
    x
  ) |>
    dplyr::rename(sample = sample_original)

  out
}

matrix_diagnostics <- function(mat, name, n_show = 5) {
  cat("\n--- Diagnostics:", name, "---\n")
  cat("dim:", paste(dim(mat), collapse = " x "), "\n")
  cat("NA count:", sum(is.na(mat)), "\n")
  cat("Non-finite count:", sum(!is.finite(mat)), "\n")
  cat("Value summary:\n")
  print(summary(as.numeric(mat)))
  cat("Sample median summary:\n")
  print(summary(apply(mat, 2, median, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat("Sample sd summary:\n")
  print(summary(apply(mat, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat("Gene mean summary:\n")
  print(summary(rowMeans(mat, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat("First genes:", paste(head(rownames(mat), n_show), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("First samples:", paste(head(colnames(mat), n_show), collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

sample_rank_normalize <- function(mat) {
  # Each column/sample is transformed independently.
  # This is a cross-platform alignment step that does not use other samples' distributions.
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  mode(mat) <- "numeric"

  out <- apply(mat, 2, function(x) {
    ok <- is.finite(x)
    z <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
    if (sum(ok) <= 1) {
      z[ok] <- 0
    } else {
      r <- rank(x[ok], ties.method = "average", na.last = "keep")
      p <- (r - 0.5) / sum(ok)
      z[ok] <- qnorm(p)
    }
    z
  })

  out <- as.matrix(out)
  rownames(out) <- rownames(mat)
  colnames(out) <- colnames(mat)
  out
}

sample_zscore <- function(mat) {
  # Each sample is centered/scaled independently across genes.
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  mode(mat) <- "numeric"
  out <- apply(mat, 2, function(x) {
    mu <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    sdv <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (!is.finite(sdv) || sdv == 0) sdv <- 1
    (x - mu) / sdv
  })
  out <- as.matrix(out)
  rownames(out) <- rownames(mat)
  colnames(out) <- colnames(mat)
  out
}

apply_cross_platform_alignment <- function(tcga_mat, gse_mat, method) {
  if (method == "sample_rank_normal") {
    list(
      tcga = sample_rank_normalize(tcga_mat),
      gse = sample_rank_normalize(gse_mat)
    )
  } else if (method == "sample_zscore") {
    list(
      tcga = sample_zscore(tcga_mat),
      gse = sample_zscore(gse_mat)
    )
  } else if (method == "none") {
    list(tcga = tcga_mat, gse = gse_mat)
  } else {
    stop("Unknown cross-platform alignment method: ", method)
  }
}

remove_bad_features <- function(mat) {
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  keep_finite <- rowSums(is.finite(mat)) == ncol(mat)
  keep_var <- apply(mat, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  keep <- keep_finite & keep_var
  out <- mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  list(data = out, keep = keep)
}
```

# 4) Read CMS labels

```{r read-labels}
labels_raw <- read.delim(
  label_path,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

label_col <- "CMS_final_network_plus_RFclassifier_in_nonconsensus_samples"
if (!(label_col %in% colnames(labels_raw))) {
  stop("Cannot find CMS label column: ", label_col)
}

labels <- labels_raw |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample = as.character(sample),
    dataset = tolower(as.character(dataset)),
    CMS = as.character(.data[[label_col]])
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(CMS), CMS %in% valid_cms) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    CMS_binary_text = ifelse(CMS == binary_positive_class, binary_positive_class, binary_negative_class),
    class_id = ifelse(CMS == binary_positive_class, 1, 0)
  )

cat("Label table loaded.\n")
cat("Total valid CMS labels:", nrow(labels), "\n")
cat("Dataset distribution in label file:\n")
print(table(labels$dataset))
cat("Original CMS distribution in all labels:\n")
print(table(labels$CMS))
cat("Binary CMS distribution in all labels:\n")
print(table(labels$CMS_binary_text))
```

# 5) Read expression data and platform-internal preprocessing

```{r read-expression}
tcga_raw <- read_tcga_expr(train_expr_path)
gse13294_raw <- read_geo_expr(val_expr_path)

cat("TCGA raw data.frame dim:", paste(dim(tcga_raw), collapse = " x "), "\n")
cat("GSE13294 raw data.frame dim:", paste(dim(gse13294_raw), collapse = " x "), "\n")
cat("TCGA preview:\n")
print(tcga_raw[1:3, 1:min(6, ncol(tcga_raw))])
cat("GSE13294 preview:\n")
print(gse13294_raw[1:3, 1:min(6, ncol(gse13294_raw))])

tcga_mat_raw <- tcga_raw |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("gene_id") |>
  to_numeric_matrix()

gse13294_mat_raw <- gse13294_raw |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("gene_id") |>
  to_numeric_matrix()

# Platform-internal preprocessing:
# TCGA: if not log-like, apply log2(x + 1). The DeepCC paper used TPM then log2 transform.
# GSE13294: this file is named RMA expression, so it is treated as already log-scale.
tcga_is_log <- is_probably_logscale(tcga_mat_raw)
cat("TCGA appears log-scale?:", tcga_is_log, "\n")
if (!tcga_is_log) {
  tcga_mat_raw <- log2(tcga_mat_raw + 1)
  cat("Applied log2(x + 1) to TCGA matrix.\n")
} else {
  cat("TCGA kept as-is because it appears log-like.\n")
}

cat("GSE13294 is assumed to be RMA log-scale. No extra log transform applied.\n")

matrix_diagnostics(tcga_mat_raw, "TCGA after platform-internal log handling, before gene-symbol collapse")
matrix_diagnostics(gse13294_mat_raw, "GSE13294 RMA matrix before probe-symbol collapse")
```

# 6) Gene-symbol harmonization

```{r gene-symbol-harmonization}
tcga_mat_symbol <- clean_tcga_symbol_matrix(tcga_mat_raw)
gse13294_mat_symbol <- collapse_gse_probe_to_symbol(gse13294_mat_raw)

matrix_diagnostics(tcga_mat_symbol, "TCGA gene-symbol matrix")
matrix_diagnostics(gse13294_mat_symbol, "GSE13294 gene-symbol matrix")

common_genes <- intersect(rownames(tcga_mat_symbol), rownames(gse13294_mat_symbol))
cat("TCGA gene count:", nrow(tcga_mat_symbol), "\n")
cat("GSE13294 gene count:", nrow(gse13294_mat_symbol), "\n")
cat("Common gene count:", length(common_genes), "\n")
cat("Common gene preview:\n")
print(head(common_genes, 30))

if (length(common_genes) < 500) {
  stop("Too few common genes after harmonization. Check gene IDs and platform annotation.")
}

tcga_common <- tcga_mat_symbol[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]
gse13294_common <- gse13294_mat_symbol[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]

matrix_diagnostics(tcga_common, "TCGA common genes before cross-platform alignment")
matrix_diagnostics(gse13294_common, "GSE13294 common genes before cross-platform alignment")
```

# 7) Sample alignment with CMS labels

```{r sample-alignment}
# TCGA CMS labels should be assigned only to tumor samples.
# Keep only primary tumor samples before patient-level CMS matching.
# TCGA sample type code:
#   01 = primary solid tumor
#   02 = recurrent solid tumor
#   06 = metastatic
#   11 = solid tissue normal

tcga_sample_type_all <- substr(colnames(tcga_common), 14, 15)

cat("TCGA sample type distribution before tumor-only filtering:\n")
print(table(tcga_sample_type_all, useNA = "ifany"))

tcga_tumor_keep <- tcga_sample_type_all == "01"
tcga_common_tumor <- tcga_common[, tcga_tumor_keep, drop = FALSE]

cat("TCGA sample type distribution after keeping primary tumor only:\n")
print(table(substr(colnames(tcga_common_tumor), 14, 15), useNA = "ifany"))
cat("TCGA common-gene matrix after primary tumor filtering dim:", dim(tcga_common_tumor), "\n")

tcga_meta <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_original = colnames(tcga_common_tumor),
  sample_lookup = clean_tcga_sample_id(colnames(tcga_common_tumor)),
  dataset = train_dataset_name,
  sample_type = substr(colnames(tcga_common_tumor), 14, 15)
) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    labels |>
      dplyr::filter(dataset == train_dataset_name) |>
      dplyr::rename(sample_lookup = sample),
    by = c("sample_lookup", "dataset")
  )

cat("TCGA sample type distribution after CMS matching:\n")
print(table(tcga_meta$sample_type, useNA = "ifany"))

gse13294_meta <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_original = colnames(gse13294_common),
  sample_lookup = clean_geo_sample_id(colnames(gse13294_common)),
  dataset = val_dataset_name
) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    labels |>
      dplyr::filter(dataset == val_dataset_name) |>
      dplyr::rename(sample_lookup = sample),
    by = c("sample_lookup", "dataset")
  )

cat("Matched TCGA samples:", nrow(tcga_meta), "\n")
cat("Matched GSE13294 samples:", nrow(gse13294_meta), "\n")

if (nrow(tcga_meta) == 0 || nrow(gse13294_meta) == 0) {
  stop("Sample alignment failed: no matched samples for TCGA or GSE13294.")
}

cat("TCGA CMS distribution after matching:\n")
print(table(tcga_meta$CMS))
cat("TCGA binary class distribution after matching:\n")
print(table(tcga_meta$class_id))
cat("GSE13294 CMS distribution after matching:\n")
print(table(gse13294_meta$CMS))
cat("GSE13294 binary class distribution after matching:\n")
print(table(gse13294_meta$class_id))

# Restrict matrices to matched samples in metadata order.
tcga_common_matched <- tcga_common_tumor[, tcga_meta$sample_original, drop = FALSE]
gse13294_common_matched <- gse13294_common[, gse13294_meta$sample_original, drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(colnames(tcga_common_matched), tcga_meta$sample_original))
stopifnot(identical(colnames(gse13294_common_matched), gse13294_meta$sample_original))

matrix_diagnostics(tcga_common_matched, "TCGA common genes matched primary tumor samples")
matrix_diagnostics(gse13294_common_matched, "GSE13294 common genes matched samples")
```

# 8) Training-only feature selection

```{r training-only-feature-selection}
# Select high-expression features using TCGA only.
# This avoids using external validation expression values to decide which genes enter the classifier.
train_gene_means <- rowMeans(tcga_common_matched, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Training-only gene mean summary before feature selection:\n")
print(summary(train_gene_means))
cat("Training-only gene mean quantiles:\n")
print(quantile(train_gene_means, probs = c(0, 0.01, 0.05, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.90, 0.95, 0.99, 1), na.rm = TRUE))

feature_rank <- order(train_gene_means, decreasing = TRUE)
actual_top_n <- min(top_n_features, length(feature_rank))
selected_genes <- names(train_gene_means)[feature_rank[seq_len(actual_top_n)]]

cat("Selected genes based on TCGA-only mean expression:", length(selected_genes), "\n")
cat("Selected gene preview:\n")
print(head(selected_genes, 30))

feature_check <- tibble::tibble(
  gene = names(train_gene_means),
  tcga_train_mean = as.numeric(train_gene_means),
  selected = names(train_gene_means) %in% selected_genes
) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(tcga_train_mean))

readr::write_csv(feature_check, file.path(result_dir, "feature_selection_tcga_only_check.csv"))

hist(
  train_gene_means,
  breaks = 200,
  main = "TCGA-only gene mean distribution for feature selection",
  xlab = "Mean expression in TCGA only",
  col = "grey85",
  border = "white"
)
abline(v = min(train_gene_means[selected_genes], na.rm = TRUE), col = "red", lwd = 2)
legend(
  "topright",
  legend = paste0("top_n = ", length(selected_genes)),
  col = "red",
  lwd = 2,
  bty = "n"
)
```

```{r}
# 8.5) Poor-marker / negative-control marker boxplot by batch
############################################################
## Boxplot of poor-marker reads by batch
## Batch 1 = TCGACRC
## Batch 2 = GSE13294
##
## Important:
## This plot is made BEFORE cross-platform alignment.
## It is for diagnostic visualization only and is not used in ml_sum().
############################################################

## 1) Define poor markers from TCGA training data only
## Here poor markers are genes with low-to-middle TCGA mean expression.
## You can adjust these quantiles if the number of genes is too large/small.

poor_q_low  <- 0.10
poor_q_high <- 0.30

poor_lower <- quantile(train_gene_means, probs = poor_q_low,  na.rm = TRUE)
poor_upper <- quantile(train_gene_means, probs = poor_q_high, na.rm = TRUE)

poor_genes <- names(train_gene_means)[
  train_gene_means >= poor_lower &
    train_gene_means <= poor_upper
]

## Exclude ML-selected high-expression features, just to keep the diagnostic set separate.
poor_genes <- setdiff(poor_genes, selected_genes)

cat("Poor-marker definition:\n")
cat("TCGA mean-expression quantile window:", poor_q_low, "to", poor_q_high, "\n")
cat("Poor-marker mean lower bound:", poor_lower, "\n")
cat("Poor-marker mean upper bound:", poor_upper, "\n")
cat("Number of poor markers:", length(poor_genes), "\n")

if (length(poor_genes) < 20) {
  stop("Too few poor markers. Widen the quantile window, e.g. 0.10 to 0.50.")
}

## 2) Build poor-marker matrix before cross-platform alignment
tcga_poor <- tcga_common_matched[poor_genes, , drop = FALSE]
gse_poor  <- gse13294_common_matched[poor_genes, , drop = FALSE]

poor_mat <- cbind(tcga_poor, gse_poor)

batch_poor <- factor(
  c(rep("TCGACRC", ncol(tcga_poor)),
    rep("13294",   ncol(gse_poor))),
  levels = c("TCGACRC", "13294")
)

stopifnot(ncol(poor_mat) == length(batch_poor))

## 3) Remove non-finite values
poor_mat[!is.finite(poor_mat)] <- NA

## 4) Order samples by batch
ord <- order(batch_poor)
poor_mat <- poor_mat[, ord, drop = FALSE]
batch_poor <- batch_poor[ord]

## 5) Compute boxplot range
bp <- boxplot(
  as.data.frame(poor_mat),
  plot = FALSE,
  outline = FALSE
)

ylim_use <- range(bp$stats, na.rm = TRUE)

## 6) Background blocks for the two batches
batch_runs <- rle(as.character(batch_poor))
batch_end <- cumsum(batch_runs$lengths)
batch_start <- c(1, head(batch_end, -1) + 1)

## Grey / white background blocks
bg_cols <- c(
  "TCGACRC" = "grey92",
  "13294"   = "white"
)

## Colorful box colors by batch
## Grey / white background blocks
bg_cols <- c(
  "TCGACRC" = "grey92",
  "13294"   = "white"
)

## Box colors by batch
box_cols <- c(
  "TCGACRC" = "#00BFC4",
  "13294"   = "#F8766D"
)

sample_box_cols <- adjustcolor(box_cols[as.character(batch_poor)], alpha.f = 0.45)
sample_border_cols <- adjustcolor(box_cols[as.character(batch_poor)], alpha.f = 0.75)

legend_box_cols <- adjustcolor(box_cols, alpha.f = 0.75)

## 7) Plot
par(mar = c(5, 5, 4, 2))

plot(
  NA,
  xlim = c(0.5, ncol(poor_mat) + 0.5),
  ylim = ylim_use,
  xaxt = "n",
  xlab = "Samples ordered by batch",
  ylab = "Poor-marker log-transformed expression",
  main = "Poor-marker expression distribution by batch"
)

## Background color by batch
for (i in seq_along(batch_runs$values)) {
  this_batch <- batch_runs$values[i]
  rect(
    xleft = batch_start[i] - 0.5,
    ybottom = par("usr")[3],
    xright = batch_end[i] + 0.5,
    ytop = par("usr")[4],
    col = bg_cols[this_batch],
    border = NA
  )
}

## One box per sample
boxplot(
  as.data.frame(poor_mat),
  add = TRUE,
  outline = FALSE,
  xaxt = "n",
  col = sample_box_cols,
  border = sample_border_cols,
  boxwex = 0.35,
  lwd = 0.6,
  medlwd = 0.6,
  whisklty = 1,
  staplelty = 1
)

## Separator between batch 1 and batch 2
abline(v = batch_end[1] + 0.5, lty = 2, col = "grey40", lwd = 1)

## Batch labels on x-axis
axis(
  side = 1,
  at = (batch_start + batch_end) / 2,
  labels = batch_runs$values,
  tick = FALSE,
  cex.axis = 0.9
)

legend(
  "right",
  legend = names(box_cols),
  fill = legend_box_cols,
  border = box_cols,
  bty = "n",
  title = "Batch",
  cex = 0.85,
  inset = c(0.01, 0)
)

## 8) Save plot
png(
  filename = file.path(result_dir, "poor_marker_boxplot_by_batch_before_alignment.png"),
  width = 4200,
  height = 1500,
  res = 300
)

par(mar = c(5, 5, 4, 2))

plot(
  NA,
  xlim = c(0.5, ncol(poor_mat) + 0.5),
  ylim = ylim_use,
  xaxt = "n",
  xlab = "Samples ordered by batch",
  ylab = "Poor-marker log-transformed expression",
  main = "Poor-marker expression distribution by batch"
)

for (i in seq_along(batch_runs$values)) {
  this_batch <- batch_runs$values[i]
  rect(
    xleft = batch_start[i] - 0.5,
    ybottom = par("usr")[3],
    xright = batch_end[i] + 0.5,
    ytop = par("usr")[4],
    col = bg_cols[this_batch],
    border = NA
  )
}

boxplot(
  as.data.frame(poor_mat),
  add = TRUE,
  outline = FALSE,
  xaxt = "n",
  col = sample_box_cols,
  border = sample_border_cols,
  boxwex = 0.35,
  lwd = 0.6,
  medlwd = 0.6,
  whisklty = 1,
  staplelty = 1
)

abline(v = batch_end[1] + 0.5, lty = 2, col = "grey40", lwd = 1)

axis(
  side = 1,
  at = (batch_start + batch_end) / 2,
  labels = batch_runs$values,
  tick = FALSE,
  cex.axis = 0.9
)

legend(
  "right",
  legend = names(box_cols),
  fill = legend_box_cols,
  border = box_cols,
  bty = "n",
  title = "Batch",
  cex = 0.85,
  inset = c(0.01, 0)
)

dev.off()

cat("Saved poor-marker boxplot to:\n")
cat(file.path(result_dir, "poor_marker_boxplot_by_batch_before_alignment.png"), "\n")
```

# 9) Cross-platform alignment without train-test-combined normalization

```{r cross-platform-alignment}
tcga_selected <- tcga_common_matched[selected_genes, , drop = FALSE]
gse13294_selected  <- gse13294_common_matched[selected_genes, , drop = FALSE]

matrix_diagnostics(tcga_selected, "TCGA selected genes before cross-platform alignment")
matrix_diagnostics(gse13294_selected, "GSE13294 selected genes before cross-platform alignment")

aligned <- apply_cross_platform_alignment(
  tcga_mat = tcga_selected,
  gse_mat = gse13294_selected,
  method = cross_platform_alignment
)

tcga_aligned <- aligned$tcga
gse13294_aligned  <- aligned$gse

matrix_diagnostics(tcga_aligned, paste0("TCGA after cross-platform alignment: ", cross_platform_alignment))
matrix_diagnostics(gse13294_aligned, paste0("GSE13294 after cross-platform alignment: ", cross_platform_alignment))

# Combine only after platform-specific preprocessing, common-gene matching,
# training-only feature selection, and independent sample-wise alignment.
data_final <- cbind(tcga_aligned, gse13294_aligned)

class_id_binary <- factor(
  c(tcga_meta$class_id, gse13294_meta$class_id),
  levels = c(0, 1)
)

batch_id_final <- c(
  rep(1, ncol(tcga_aligned)),
  rep(2, ncol(gse13294_aligned))
)
names(batch_id_final) <- colnames(data_final)

sample_meta_final <- tibble::tibble(
  sample = colnames(data_final),
  dataset = c(rep(train_dataset_name, ncol(tcga_aligned)), rep(val_dataset_name, ncol(gse13294_aligned))),
  batch_id = batch_id_final,
  CMS = c(tcga_meta$CMS, gse13294_meta$CMS),
  CMS_binary = ifelse(as.character(class_id_binary) == "1", binary_positive_class, binary_negative_class),
  class_id = as.character(class_id_binary)
)

bad_removed <- remove_bad_features(data_final)
data_final_clean <- bad_removed$data

cat("Combined data_final dim before bad-feature removal:", paste(dim(data_final), collapse = " x "), "\n")
cat("Combined data_final_clean dim after bad-feature removal:", paste(dim(data_final_clean), collapse = " x "), "\n")
cat("Removed bad features:", nrow(data_final) - nrow(data_final_clean), "\n")

stopifnot(
  ncol(data_final_clean) == length(class_id_binary),
  ncol(data_final_clean) == length(batch_id_final),
  identical(colnames(data_final_clean), names(batch_id_final)),
  !anyNA(class_id_binary),
  all(class_id_binary %in% c(0, 1))
)

cat("Final class x batch table:\n")
print(table(class_id_binary, batch_id_final))
cat("Final CMS x batch table:\n")
print(table(sample_meta_final$CMS, sample_meta_final$batch_id))

matrix_diagnostics(data_final_clean, "Final data passed into ml_sum")

readr::write_csv(sample_meta_final, file.path(result_dir, "sample_meta_final.csv"))
write.table(
  data.frame(gene = rownames(data_final_clean)),
  file = file.path(result_dir, "final_feature_genes.txt"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r optional-visual-checks, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
# PCA is only for diagnostics. It is not used by ml_sum().
pca_input <- t(data_final_clean)
pca_input[!is.finite(pca_input)] <- 0
pca_fit <- prcomp(pca_input, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

pca_df <- data.frame(

p_pca_batch <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = factor(batch_id), shape = CMS_binary)) +

```

```{r}
## 9.5) Post-alignment diagnostic-feature boxplot by batch
############################################################
## Purpose:
##   Explain why the ml_sum() error curve is meaningful under
##   the batch definition:
##     Batch 1 = TCGACRC
##     Batch 2 = GSE13294
##
## Important:
##   This plot is made AFTER cross-platform alignment.
##   It uses data_final_clean, which is the same matrix passed
##   into ml_sum().
##
## Note:
##   Section 9 aligns only selected_genes, so the original poor_genes
##   from #8.5 are usually not available after alignment.
##   Therefore, this cell uses a low-to-middle expression diagnostic
##   subset from the aligned features that actually enter ml_sum().
############################################################

## 0) Required post-alignment objects
if (!exists("data_final_clean")) {
  stop("Cannot find data_final_clean. Run Section 9 cross-platform alignment first.")
}

if (!exists("batch_id_final")) {
  stop("Cannot find batch_id_final. Run Section 9 cross-platform alignment first.")
}

if (!exists("train_gene_means")) {
  stop("Cannot find train_gene_means. Run Section 8 feature selection first.")
}

if (!exists("selected_genes")) {
  stop("Cannot find selected_genes. Run Section 8 feature selection first.")
}

stopifnot(
  ncol(data_final_clean) == length(batch_id_final),
  identical(colnames(data_final_clean), names(batch_id_final))
)

cat("Post-alignment matrix used by ml_sum:\n")
print(dim(data_final_clean))

cat("Batch counts in data_final_clean:\n")
print(table(batch_id_final))

## 1) Define diagnostic features from aligned ml_sum input
## Because data_final_clean only contains selected_genes, we select
## the lower-to-middle expression subset among the available aligned
## ml_sum features, based on TCGA training means.

pa_available_genes <- intersect(rownames(data_final_clean), names(train_gene_means))

pa_feature_means <- train_gene_means[pa_available_genes]

## Low-to-middle window among available ml_sum features
## This is not the same as #8.5 raw poor_genes. It is a post-alignment
## diagnostic subset from features that actually enter ml_sum().
pa_q_low  <- 0.10
pa_q_high <- 0.40

pa_lower <- quantile(pa_feature_means, probs = pa_q_low,  na.rm = TRUE)
pa_upper <- quantile(pa_feature_means, probs = pa_q_high, na.rm = TRUE)

pa_diag_genes <- names(pa_feature_means)[
  pa_feature_means >= pa_lower &
    pa_feature_means <= pa_upper
]

cat("\nPost-alignment diagnostic-feature definition:\n")
cat("Feature source: data_final_clean rows, i.e. features entering ml_sum()\n")
cat("TCGA mean-expression quantile window among aligned features:", pa_q_low, "to", pa_q_high, "\n")
cat("Diagnostic-feature mean lower bound:", pa_lower, "\n")
cat("Diagnostic-feature mean upper bound:", pa_upper, "\n")
cat("Number of diagnostic features:", length(pa_diag_genes), "\n")

## Fallback: if too few features, use all aligned ml_sum features
if (length(pa_diag_genes) < 20) {
  warning(
    paste0(
      "Fewer than 20 diagnostic features found. ",
      "Using all data_final_clean features for the post-alignment boxplot."
    )
  )
  pa_diag_genes <- rownames(data_final_clean)
}

## 2) Build post-alignment diagnostic matrix
pa_diag_mat <- data_final_clean[pa_diag_genes, , drop = FALSE]

pa_batch <- factor(
  ifelse(batch_id_final == 1, "TCGACRC", "GSE13294"),
  levels = c("TCGACRC", "GSE13294")
)

stopifnot(ncol(pa_diag_mat) == length(pa_batch))

## 3) Remove non-finite values
pa_diag_mat[!is.finite(pa_diag_mat)] <- NA

cat("\nFinite values per sample summary in post-alignment diagnostic matrix:\n")
print(summary(colSums(is.finite(as.matrix(pa_diag_mat)))))

cat("All-NA samples:\n")
print(sum(colSums(is.finite(as.matrix(pa_diag_mat))) == 0))

## 4) Order samples by batch
pa_ord <- order(pa_batch)

pa_diag_mat_ordered <- pa_diag_mat[, pa_ord, drop = FALSE]
pa_batch_ordered <- pa_batch[pa_ord]

## 5) Compute boxplot range
pa_bp <- boxplot(
  as.data.frame(pa_diag_mat_ordered),
  plot = FALSE,
  outline = FALSE
)

pa_ylim_use <- range(pa_bp$stats, na.rm = TRUE)

## 6) Background blocks for the two batches
pa_batch_runs <- rle(as.character(pa_batch_ordered))
pa_batch_end <- cumsum(pa_batch_runs$lengths)
pa_batch_start <- c(1, head(pa_batch_end, -1) + 1)

pa_bg_cols <- c(
  "TCGACRC"  = "grey92",
  "GSE13294" = "white"
)

pa_box_cols <- c(
  "TCGACRC"  = "#00BFC4",
  "GSE13294" = "#F8766D"
)

pa_sample_box_cols <- adjustcolor(
  pa_box_cols[as.character(pa_batch_ordered)],
  alpha.f = 0.45
)

pa_sample_border_cols <- adjustcolor(
  pa_box_cols[as.character(pa_batch_ordered)],
  alpha.f = 0.75
)

pa_legend_box_cols <- adjustcolor(
  unname(pa_box_cols),
  alpha.f = 0.75
)
names(pa_legend_box_cols) <- names(pa_box_cols)

if (any(is.na(pa_sample_box_cols)) || any(is.na(pa_sample_border_cols))) {
  stop("Some samples do not have assigned colors. Check pa_batch_ordered and pa_box_cols.")
}

cat("\nPost-alignment batch counts used for plotting:\n")
print(table(pa_batch_ordered))

## 7) Define one plotting function to avoid RStudio/png mismatch
pa_draw_post_alignment_boxplot <- function() {
  pa_old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(pa_old_par))
  
  par(mar = c(5, 5, 4, 2))
  
  plot(
    NA,
    xlim = c(0.5, ncol(pa_diag_mat_ordered) + 0.5),
    ylim = pa_ylim_use,
    xaxt = "n",
    xlab = "Samples ordered by batch",
    ylab = "Post-alignment diagnostic-feature expression",
    main = "Post-alignment feature distribution by batch"
  )
  
  ## Background color by batch
  for (pa_i in seq_along(pa_batch_runs$values)) {
    pa_this_batch <- pa_batch_runs$values[pa_i]
    rect(
      xleft = pa_batch_start[pa_i] - 0.5,
      ybottom = par("usr")[3],
      xright = pa_batch_end[pa_i] + 0.5,
      ytop = par("usr")[4],
      col = pa_bg_cols[pa_this_batch],
      border = NA
    )
  }
  
  ## One box per sample
  boxplot(
    as.data.frame(pa_diag_mat_ordered),
    add = TRUE,
    outline = FALSE,
    xaxt = "n",
    col = pa_sample_box_cols,
    border = pa_sample_border_cols,
    boxwex = 0.35,
    lwd = 0.6,
    medlwd = 0.6,
    whisklty = 1,
    staplelty = 1
  )
  
  ## Separator between TCGACRC and GSE13294
  abline(
    v = pa_batch_end[1] + 0.5,
    lty = 2,
    col = "grey40",
    lwd = 1
  )
  
  ## Batch labels on x-axis
  axis(
    side = 1,
    at = (pa_batch_start + pa_batch_end) / 2,
    labels = pa_batch_runs$values,
    tick = FALSE,
    cex.axis = 0.9
  )
  
  legend(
    "right",
    legend = names(pa_box_cols),
    fill = pa_legend_box_cols,
    border = pa_box_cols,
    bty = "n",
    title = "Batch",
    cex = 0.85,
    inset = c(0.01, 0)
  )
}

## 8) Plot on screen
pa_draw_post_alignment_boxplot()

## 9) Save plot
pa_outfile <- file.path(
  result_dir,
  "post_alignment_diagnostic_feature_boxplot_TCGACRC_vs_GSE13294.png"
)

png(
  filename = pa_outfile,
  width = 4200,
  height = 1500,
  res = 300
)

pa_draw_post_alignment_boxplot()

dev.off()

cat("Saved post-alignment diagnostic-feature boxplot to:\n")
cat(pa_outfile, "\n")
```

# 11) Run ml_sum from SSV summary.R

```{r run-ml-sum}
cat("Running ml_sum() using SSV summary.R.\n")
cat("Important: data_type_rnaseq = FALSE because input is already cross-platform aligned continuous expression scores.\n")
cat("Normalization methods inside ml_sum for this branch: non, qn, mn, vsn.\n")
cat("The qn/mn/vsn implementations in SSV summary.R fit on train and apply to test, rather than normalizing train+test together.\n")

start_time <- Sys.time()

ml_sum(
  n = times,
  data = data_final_clean,
  class = class_id_binary,
  batch = batch_id_final,
  batch_time = TRUE,
  early_batch_id = c(1),
  batch_balance = batch_balance,
  ml = ml_methods,
  split_combination = split_combination,
  data_type_rnaseq = FALSE,
  file = file_prefix
)

end_time <- Sys.time()
run_time <- end_time - start_time
cat("ml_sum run time:\n")
print(run_time)
```

)
